record.name: CV Maker AI: Resume & ATS
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Make your CV free. Pick a professional design, fill it in and send it as PDF or Word. No account.
Want more? The AI writes it, translates it and checks it against the job. Pay once, no subscription.

ALREADY HAVE A CV?
Photograph it, pick the PDF or paste the text. The AI turns it into an editable document you can translate, in seconds. No retyping.

STARTING FRESH? ANSWER, DON'T WRITE
CV Maker AI interviews you like a career coach. Your name, role and years of experience go in with three taps, and your CV appears on screen from the first one. Then it asks the questions recruiters care about, such as how many people you managed and what changed because of your work, and every answer lands on the page as you talk.

ONE TAP, TWO LANGUAGES
Get a properly formatted Arabic version of your English CV, or the reverse. Real right to left layout, professional Gulf conventions, and brand names kept in Latin letters. Not machine translation pasted in the wrong direction.

APPLYING SOMEWHERE? PASTE THE AD
See exactly which requirements your CV covers and which are missing, then tailor it to that job. The AI follows one rule: it only rephrases and reorders what you actually have. It never invents skills or experience. A matching cover letter and the likely interview questions come from the same ad.

PRACTISE THE INTERVIEW FIRST
A mock interview for the job you are applying to. Every answer is scored, weakest first, with what to say instead.

KNOW YOUR SCORE BEFORE YOU SEND
An honest score out of 100 for your finished CV, covering completeness, impact, clarity and ATS readiness, with exactly what to fix. No flattery. A real 55 with clear tips beats a comforting 85.

FOR ANY EMPLOYER, ANYWHERE
Clean ATS friendly templates for international companies, and Gulf style templates with photo, nationality and visa status when the employer expects them. You choose when you export.
Designer templates with accent colours, chosen from live previews of your own CV.
Tap any line to edit it, or let the smart editor rewrite it, shorten it or fix the tone.
Real PDF and Word export with crisp text, never an image.
Send your CV by email with a ready written application message.

NO ACCOUNT. NO NONSENSE.
No sign up, no email, nothing to remember. Your documents stay on your device.

HONEST PRICING
Free: one CV from our templates or examples, with a small watermark.

CV Pack: a one time purchase, not a subscription. Every feature unlocked for good, plus a bundle of AI actions that never expires: the AI coach, import, translation, ATS checks, tailoring, cover letters and practice interviews.

Pro, for CV Pack owners: an auto renewing subscription, monthly or yearly, with unlimited personal use of every AI feature.

Pro renews automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. You can manage or cancel it anytime in your Apple Account settings under Subscriptions. Prices are shown in the app and may vary by region.

Privacy Policy: https://cvbuilder.hashcode.ae/privacy.html
Terms of Use: https://cvbuilder.hashcode.ae/terms.html

record.name: ResumUp: AI Resume CV Builder
record.offering: Business app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
ResumUp is a professional resume builder that helps you create polished resumes and understand how well your experience matches a job.

Build your resume step by step, choose a template, customize the design, and export a polished PDF when you're ready.

Create Professional Resumes
Add your personal details, work experience, education, skills, languages, projects, certifications, and awards in a simple guided flow.

Customize Your Resume
Choose from professional templates and personalize your resume with different colors and fonts while previewing your changes in real time.

Resume Progress
See how complete your resume is as you add information. Resume Progress is calculated locally from the sections you complete and does not represent hiring probability or resume quality.

AI Job Matching
Compare a resume with a job description to see which requirements are supported by your experience, which could be clearer, and which are not found in your resume.

You can analyze a resume created in ResumUp or upload an existing PDF resume.

AI Suggestions
When supported by information already present in your resume, ResumUp can suggest clearer wording without inventing experience, skills, or achievements.

Tailored Resume Copies
For resumes created in ResumUp, review AI suggestions and create a separate tailored copy while keeping your original resume unchanged.

Job Match History
Review previous job matching results without running a new analysis.

PDF Export
Export your finished resume as a professional PDF, ready to share with employers.

Your resumes are stored locally on your device. AI Job Matching processes your selected resume and job description only when you choose to run an analysis.

Some features are available with a ResumUp Pro subscription.

How it works

1. Import your experience
   Upload your resume, notes, or career materials.

2. Paste a job description
   TailorCV reviews the role and finds the key requirements.

3. Generate a tailored resume
   Create a resume draft matched to the target role.

4. Create an outreach message
   Get a ready to send intro message for recruiters and applications.

5. Export and apply
   Download a clean professional PDF resume.

TailorCV is useful for internship applications, career changes, first job seekers, international job applications, and high volume job applications.

Apply smarter. Not harder.

Create a professional resume from your existing CV or personal notes with the help of AI.

Upload and Improve

Create from Notes

Preview your resume as you edit and export the final document as a high-quality PDF.

Zeviro uses security-focused systems to process and protect your resume data and uploaded documents.

▸ Voice mode runs like a real phone call. Tap the mic, deliver your pitch, the buyer pushes back in their own voice.

▸ Text mode reads like iMessage. Faster reps, lower stakes, same coaching.

▸ Every call ends with a letter grade, the exact line you flubbed, and the line a top closer would have used.

Stay on top of every lead across your connected accounts, see what's working with clear metrics, and never miss a follow-up. You stay in control: Theos suggests, you decide.

CONVERSATIONS
- See all your sales conversations in one inbox, across your connected accounts
- Search, filter and sort by unread, unanswered, status, label, channel or campaign
- Real-time updates as new messages arrive and AI drafts are ready
- Read the full history: text, links, images, videos, files and audio

AI REPLIES — YOU APPROVE
- Review, edit, and approve or reject every AI-suggested draft before it's sent
- Generate or regenerate a response based on your active prompt
- Refine your wording: fix it, or make it friendlier, more professional or more concise
- Choose your AI model: Auto, Fast, Pro or Max
- Write manually or dictate by voice

LEADS & CONTACTS
- See each contact's profile, role, location and bio
- Review AI lead qualification and priority scoring, with the reasoning behind it
- Pause, leave or block a conversation whenever you want

METRICS
- Track meetings booked, invitations sent and acceptance rate
- See messages sent, received and answered, plus your response rate
- Filter by date range, platform, account and campaign

CALENDAR
- Connect Google Calendar to see your meetings inside Theos
- Join, reschedule, copy meeting links and add guests
- Set your availability by day and time slot

PROMPTS
- Tell Theos about your business, products and audience
- Set your qualification criteria and goal: sales or meetings
- Add custom instructions for tone and context

NOTIFICATIONS
- Get alerted when drafts are ready, labels change or campaigns need attention
- Jump straight to the related conversation

Theos AI works alongside the Theos web app, where you connect your accounts and set things up.

Questions or feedback? https://www.theos.ai/en-us/contact

AI Sales Dialer & Meeting Intelligence

Turn every call and meeting into revenue insights.
Revenue.io is the AI-powered mobile dialer and meeting recorder built for sales teams. Call prospects, record conversations, and get instant summaries so you can stay focused on selling and moving deals forward.
Whether you are prospecting, running meetings, or following up with buyers, Revenue.io helps you capture every conversation and turn it into actionable intelligence.

Power Through Prospecting with an AI Sales Dialer

Accelerate outbound calling with a mobile dialer designed for modern sales teams.
 • Automated dialing
 • Local presence dialing
 • Voicemail drop
 • Click-to-call from anywhere
 • Prioritized call lists
 • Call routing and transfers
 • Automatic activity capture
Connect with more buyers and keep your pipeline moving from anywhere.

Record and Capture Sales Meetings

Capture both phone calls and in-person meetings with built-in conversation intelligence.
Revenue.io automatically:

 • Transcribes meetings and calls

Use these insights to improve conversations and build stronger relationships with buyers.

Built for Your Revenue Stack

Keep your sales activity organized and accessible across your team.

Designed for Sales Teams on the Move

Whether you are prospecting, meeting with customers, or following up on deals, Revenue.io helps sales teams stay productive anywhere.
Download Revenue.io and turn every conversation into revenue intelligence.

Keyboard Genius isn't just an AI input method—it’s your all-in-one communication powerhouse. Close more deals with "Sales Mode" and win hearts with "High-EQ Social Mode." Turn every text into a masterpiece of logic and charm.

5-Stage Pipeline Management: Precision guidance through every phase: Lead → Connection → Intent → Closing → Referral.
Real-time AI "Move-for-Move" Strategy: Paste a client’s objection, and the AI instantly generates the perfect counter-strategy.
Industry-Specific SOPs: Continuous updates for Real Estate, Automotive, SaaS, Education, Logistics, Finance, and more.
CRM & Task Integration: Manage client info and follow-ups directly from your keyboard.
Personal Script Library: Save your best-performing lines in an unlimited private database.
AI-Driven Logic: Built on systematic sales theories and consumer psychology, our AI analyzes the chat context to suggest the optimal response structure, increasing your reply and conversion rates.

2. AI Smart Reply — Native Fluency in Every Style

Contextual Polishing: Copy your draft, and let AI rewrite it into "Consultative," "High-Pressure Close," or "Professional Follow-up" versions.
Instant Objection Handling: Paste a client’s message to generate targeted responses for price haggling, risk hesitation, or ghosting.

3. Dating & Social Wingman — Master the Art of Connection

High-EQ Communication: More than just sales—it's your secret weapon for dating and social success.
Relationship Progression: Seamlessly navigate through Icebreaking → First Contact → Building Heat → The Date → Deep Connection.
Scene-Specific Tools: * Creative Openers & Humorous Banter
Emotional Support & "How to Apologize" Tips
Smooth Date Invitations & Romantic Expressions
From "Awkward" to "Charming": Stop being a conversation killer. Control the rhythm, build attraction, and create genuine emotional bonds.

II. FAQ & Quick Setup

1. How to Enable Keyboard Genius?

Option A: Open the Keyboard Genius App → Enable "Full Access" and "Paste Permissions."
Option B: Go to System Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboards → Add New Keyboard → Select "Keyboard Genius" → Toggle "Allow Full Access."
To Use: Long-press the "Globe" icon in any text field and switch to Keyboard Genius.

2. How to Enable Paste Permissions?

Within the App: Tap "Enable Paste Permission" and select "Allow."
In Settings: System Settings → General → Keyboard → Keyboard Genius → "Paste from Other Apps" → Set to "Allow."

Every pilot has a simulator — now salespeople do too.

SalesDojo is an AI sales simulator that lets you practice real sales conversations with lifelike AI buyers.
They talk, interrupt, ask tough questions, and challenge you just like real prospects.
After each call, you receive a full breakdown of your performance — discovery, listening, objection handling, closing, confidence, and product knowledge.

Choose your scenario – prospecting, demo, upsell, or renewal.

Select your AI buyer persona – from friendly to skeptical.

Talk to your AI buyer – they react in real time to what you say.

Review your analysis – get detailed feedback and skill scores.

Every session helps you improve faster and build confidence for real conversations.

Realistic AI buyers that challenge your thinking and adapt to your tone.

Instant feedback after every call with actionable coaching tips.

Skill tracking across discovery, objection handling, closing, and more.

Adjustable difficulty to simulate everything from warm demos to hard-nosed executives.

Anyone who wants to sound confident and close better.
